name: data-bar-stagger
title: Staggered Bar Chart
description: Năm cột biểu đồ mọc lên từ trục đáy lần lượt cách nhau 75 ms, sáng dần khi cao lên.

moworks.author: takayu

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio bar-chart-stagger, written here): 5 bars (9 % wide, 15 % apart, heights 24 % + 8 % per bar, top radius 3, accent mixed darker to lighter) on a 1 px axis. Each bar scaleY 0.04 → 1 from the bottom with opacity 0.35 → 1, power2.out; bar k starts k × 75 ms later and all finish at 1.1 s (later bars move faster). Params: each (0.075 s) · duration (1.1 s) · from (0.04) · ease (power2.out). Later bars start later but all land together, so they move faster.
